movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

movers24h.product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services Insufficient Granularity of Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Defender Link Following Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability due to improper file handling on the API interface of an affected system. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by uploading a malicious file on the local file system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to overwrite arbitrary files on the affected system and gain vmanage user privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Storing Passwords in a Recoverable Format Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a storing passwords in a recoverable format vulnerability that allows an authenticated, local attacker to gain DCA user privileges by accessing a credential file for the DCA user on the filesystem as a low-privileged user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Client Download of Code Without Integrity Check Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: TrueConf Client contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability. An attacker who is able to influence the update delivery path can substitute a tampered update payload. If the payload is executed or installed by the updater, this may result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the updating process or user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Locking Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple watchOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS contain an improper locking vulnerability that could allow a malicious application to cause unexpected changes in memory shared between processes.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Classic UI where attackers could abuse Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) @import directives in email HTML.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS and iPadOS Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS and iPadOS contain a use-after-free vulnerability. An app may be able to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a memory corruption vulnerability while using alignments for memory allocation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow an attacker with memory write the capability to execute arbitrary code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Desktop Windows Manager contains a type confusion vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Word Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Word contains a reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Prettier eslint-config-prettier Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Prettier eslint-config-prettier contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability. Installing an affected package executes an install.js file that launches the node-gyp.dll malware on Windows.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Android Framework Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Android Runtime Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Android Runtime contains a use-after-free vulnerability potentially allowing a chrome sandbox escape leading to local privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Ownership Management Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper ownership management vulnerability, where unauthorized access to the execution of the setuid file with capabilities was found in the Linux kernel’s OverlayFS subsystem in how a user copies a capable file from a nosuid mount into another mount. This uid mapping bug allows a local user to escalate their privileges on the system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Srimax Output Messenger Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Srimax Output Messenger contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to access sensitive files outside the intended directory, potentially leading to configuration leakage or arbitrary file access.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Dante Discovery Process Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Dante Discovery contains a process control vulnerability in mDNSResponder.exe that all allows for a DLL sideloading attack. A local attacker can leverage this vulnerability in the Dante Application Library to execute arbitrary code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain an unspecified vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content that may lead to a cross-site scripting (XSS) attack.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the nft_object, allowing local attackers to escalate privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) Core Library Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) Core Library contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for local privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft .NET Core and Visual Studio Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft .NET Core and Visual Studio contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial-of-service (DoS).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Reflected Amplification Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS URL filtering policy misconfiguration could allow a network-based attacker to conduct reflected and amplified TCP denial-of-service (RDoS) attacks.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Graphics Device Interface (GDI) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Graphics Device Interface (GDI) in Microsoft Windows allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Apple iOS kernel allows attackers to obtain sensitive information from memory via a crafted application.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: WebKitGTK Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: WebKitGTK contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: macOS Monterey contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow an application to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Event Tracing Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Event Tracing contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Kernel Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Stack-based buffer overflow in the RtlQueryRegistryValues function in win32k.sys in Microsoft Windows allows local users to gain privileges, and bypass the User Account Control (UAC) feature.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Windows when the Win32k component fails to properly handle objects in memory.

movers24h.product: Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

movers24h.product: Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

movers24h.product: IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS and XE Software Internet Key Exchange Memory Leak Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the implementation of Internet Key Exchange Version 1 (IKEv1) functionality in Cisco IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause an affected device to reload, resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Win32k contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the Windows kernel-mode driver failing to properly handle objects in memory.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple OS X Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The XPC implementation in Admin Framework in Apple OS X before 10.10.3 allows local users to bypass authentication and obtain admin privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain a type confusion vulnerability that may allow a malicious application to execute code with kernel privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS Mail contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability which may allow memory modification or application termination when processing a maliciously crafted mail message.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS XR Software DVMRP Memory Exhaustion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco IOS XR Distance Vector Multicast Routing Protocol (DVMRP) incorrectly handles Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP) packets. Exploitation could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to immediately crash the IGMP process or make it consume available memory and eventually crash.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS XR Software DVMRP Memory Exhaustion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco IOS XR Distance Vector Multicast Routing Protocol (DVMRP) incorrectly handles Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP) packets. Exploitation could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to immediately crash the IGMP process or make it consume available memory and eventually crash.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Desktop Window Manager (DWM) Core Library Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Desktop Window Manager (DWM) Core Library contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Installer Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Installer contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when MSI packages process symbolic links, which allows attackers to bypass access restrictions to add or remove files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Metabase SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: MDaemon Email Server Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: MDaemon Email Server contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to load arbitrary JavaScript code via an HTML e-mail message.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma FreePBX Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sangoma FreePBX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability due to insufficiently sanitized user-supplied data allows unauthenticated access to FreePBX Administrator leading to arbitrary database manipulation and remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine contains an injection vulnerability in a specific API of Cisco ISE and Cisco ISE-PIC due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input allowing an attacker to exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted API request. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution and obtaining root privileges on an affected device.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link TL-WR841N Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: TP-Link TL-WR841N contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default, leading to the disclose of stored credentials. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DSL-2750B Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: D-Link DSL-2750B devices contain a command injection vulnerability that allows remote, unauthenticated command injection via the login.cgi cli parameter.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco IOS XE contains a command injection vulnerability in the web user interface. When chained with CVE-2023-20198, the attacker can leverage the new local user to elevate privilege to root and write the implant to the file system. Cisco identified CVE-2023-20273 as the vulnerability exploited to deploy the implant. CVE-2021-1435, previously associated with the exploitation events, is no longer believed to be related to this activity.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that exists in the Parental Control page. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft MSHTML Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft MSHTML contains a unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) contains a security feature bypass vulnerability resulting in a limited loss of integrity and availability of security features.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup and Replication Deserialization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Veeam Backup and Replication contains a deserialization vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services contains a deserialization vulnerability when handling page requests incorrectly. An authenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the Report Server service account.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure contain a command injection vulnerability in the web components of these products, which can allow an authenticated administrator to send crafted requests to execute code on affected appliances. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2023-46805, an authenticated bypass issue.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Qlik Sense HTTP Tunneling Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability due to the incomplete fix of CVE-2021-44228, where the Thread Context Lookup Pattern is vulnerable to remote code execution in certain non-default configurations.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server allows for server-side request forgery. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082 which allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: dotCMS Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: dotCMS ContentResource API contains an unrestricted upload of file with a dangerous type vulnerability that allows for directory traversal, in which the file is saved outside of the intended storage location. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in MailboxImportServlet. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-27925 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Quest KACE System Management Appliance Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The '/common/download_agent_installer.php' script in the Quest KACE System Management Appliance is accessible by anonymous users and can be abused to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SMBv1 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The SMBv1 server in multiple Microsoft Windows versions allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat JBoss Application Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The JBoss Application Server, shipped with Red Hat Enterprise Application Platform 5.2, allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted serialized data.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache HTTP Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
movers7d.shortDescription: A crafted request uri-path can cause mod_proxy to forward the request to an origin server choosen by the remote user. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server 2.4.48 and earlier.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Validation Key Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server Validation Key fails to properly create unique keys at install time, allowing for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability due to the Windows Print Spooler service improperly performing privileged file operations. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to perform remote code execution with SYSTEM privileges. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of PrintNightmare.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Missing Authorization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SimpleHelp contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow low-privileged technicians to create API keys with excessive permissions. These API keys can be used to escalate privileges to the server admin role.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for sensitive information disclosure when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Search Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Search contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file, leading to remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB UnRAR Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: RARLAB UnRAR on Linux and UNIX contains a directory traversal vulnerability, allowing an attacker to write to files during an extract (unpack) operation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Polkit Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Red Hat polkit pkexec utility contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation with administrative rights.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SMBv1 Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory via a crafted packet.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WinRAR Absolute Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: WinRAR Absolute Path Traversal vulnerability leads to Remote Code Execution

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Oracle Corporation WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Oracle Corporation WebLogic Server contains a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: BQE BillQuick Web Suite SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: BQE BillQuick Web Suite contains an SQL injection vulnerability when accessing the username parameter that may allow for unauthenticated, remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way objects are handled in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user. This vulnerability is known to be chained with CVE-2018-0798.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SimpleHelp remote support software contains multiple path traversal vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to download arbitrary files from the SimpleHelp host via crafted HTTP requests. These files may include server configuration files and hashed user passwords.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS contain a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an attacker to read local files and execute code on the SSL VPN gateway.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: ZK Framework AuUploader Unspecified Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: ZK Framework AuUploader servlets contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to retrieve the content of a file located in the web context. The ZK Framework is an open-source Java framework. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to ConnectWise R1Soft Server Backup Manager.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortra GoAnywhere MFT Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortra (formerly, HelpSystems) GoAnywhere MFT contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the License Response Servlet due to deserializing an attacker-controlled object.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

newest.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.
